newsitem.title: UK: UK shares edge higher in wake of Dow recovery.
newsitem.headline: UK shares edge higher in wake of Dow recovery.

text.p: UK stocks crept higher in early trade on Tuesday, recovering from their biggest one-day drop in two months on the back of a sharp rebound on Wall Street.
The FTSE 100 was up 10.7 points at 3,930.4 with prices marked a shade higher across the board. Gaining stocks outweighed losers by some seven-to-one.

Yet volume remained thin and traders said gains would be capped as the market awaited news from yesterday's UK monetary policy meeting as well as today's meeting of the Federal Reserve's policy-making committee, due to be held later this afternoon.
